D_decision: Should 'adaptive rhetorical resonance' be minted as a named, governed, first-class design axis for counterpart-facing artifacts?
E_entity: ARCS method + counterpart-artifact pipeline (forge / recoil-ship); decided by Zach, surfaced during the Todd/PRL session
W_window: Now — minted 2026-08-10; applies going forward to every counterpart artifact family
true_north: Mint adaptive rhetorical resonance: tune an artifact's delivery (frame, word, cadence, emphasis) to the counterpart's register read from the recoil, while holding the facts invariant.
why: A defensible fact in the counterpart's own idiom lands where the same fact in our idiom bounces. Resonance lowers resistance and raises comprehension without overclaiming. Evidenced across the Todd/PRL family this session, where every surface speaks his register and the spec copy reuses the exact language he was already given.

tributaries.text: The deeper question: which parts of an artifact are invariant (facts, receipts) versus tunable (rhetoric, framing)? Resonance lives strictly on the tunable layer; the air-gap keeps them separate.

The failure mode is resonance sliding into flattery or fabrication. The register gauntlet + honesty gate + verify-against-their-own-words are the load-bearing guards; without them this becomes manipulation.
Cross-domain echo: this is impedance matching — deliver the signal in the medium's own frequency so it transfers instead of reflecting. Same physics as the resonance-gradient north star.

nci_note: High coherence: names existing implicit practice, bounded by explicit guards, tied to prior canon (ADR-039 refusal-to-overclaim, resonance-gradient north star). Low novelty risk.
